name: Adam Schiff
role: US Senator from California (since 2025); US Representative 2001-2024; lead House impeachment manager (2019-2020)
summary: Adam Schiff is a Democratic US Senator from California, formerly a House member and chair of the House Intelligence Committee, and lead House manager in the first Trump impeachment. His voting record is consistently liberal: for the ACA, minimum wage increases, abortion and LGBT rights, gun background checks and climate bills, against the 2017 tax cut and Keystone XL. He voted for the 2002 Iraq authorization and for FISA reauthorizations. This audit rests mainly on votes, so many statements are left unanswered.
